title: Using DNA flow-stretching assay as a tool to validate the tagging of DNA-binding proteins for single-molecule experiments
authors: Miranda Molina; Lindsey E. Way; Zhongqing Ren; Qin Liao; Xindan Wang; HyeongJun Kim
one_liner_zh: 该文利用单分子DNA流动拉伸实验评估KCK标签对DNA结合蛋白ParB功能的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但无AI或物理模拟方法，属于实验验证类，对本课题的标签设计有参考价值。
abstract: Due to the enhanced labeling capability of maleimide-based fluorescent probes, lysine-cysteine-lysine (KCK) tags are frequently added to proteins for visualization. In this study, we employed in vitro single-molecule DNA flow-stretching assay as a sensitive way to assess the impact of the KCK-tag on the property of DNA-binding proteins. Using Bacillus subtilis ParB as an example, we show that, although no noticeable changes were detected by in vivo fluorescence imaging and chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) assays, the KCK-tag substantially altered ParB’s DNA compaction rates, its response to nucleotide binding and to the presence of the specific sequence ( parS ) on the DNA. While it is typically assumed that short peptide tags minimally perturb protein function, our results urge researchers to carefully validate the use of tags for protein labeling. Our comprehensive analysis can be expanded and used as a guide to assess the impacts of other tags on DNA-binding proteins in single-molecule assays. Motivation Single-molecule fluorescence microscopy has been extensively used in modern biology to define the molecular action of proteins. Appending short peptide tags is a common strategy to enhance fluorescence labeling. In this Resources article, we evaluate the impact of a commonly used tag, the lysine-cysteine-lysine (KCK) tag, on protein behavior in single-molecule DNA flow-stretching assay, which is a sensitive and versatile method to understand the action of DNA-binding proteins. Our motivation is to provide researchers with an experimental framework to validate the fluorescently labeled DNA-binding proteins in single-molecule methods.
abstract_zh: 由于马来酰亚胺类荧光探针的标记能力增强，赖氨酸-半胱氨酸-赖氨酸（KCK）标签常被添加到蛋白质上以实现可视化。在本研究中，我们采用体外单分子DNA流动拉伸实验作为一种灵敏的方法，评估KCK标签对DNA结合蛋白性质的影响。以枯草芽孢杆菌ParB为例，我们表明，尽管体内荧光成像和染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）实验未检测到明显变化，但KCK标签显著改变了ParB的DNA压缩速率、其对核苷酸结合以及DNA上特定序列（parS）存在的响应。虽然通常假设短肽标签对蛋白质功能的扰动极小，但我们的结果促使研究人员谨慎验证用于蛋白质标记的标签。我们的综合分析可扩展并用作指南，以评估其他标签在单分子实验中对DNA结合蛋白的影响。动机单分子荧光显微镜已广泛用于现代生物学中定义蛋白质的分子作用。附加短肽标签是增强荧光标记的常见策略。在本资源文章中，我们评估了一种常用标签——赖氨酸-半胱氨酸-赖氨酸（KCK）标签——在单分子DNA流动拉伸实验中对蛋白质行为的影响，该实验是理解DNA结合蛋白作用的灵敏且多功能的方法。我们的动机是为研究人员提供一个实验框架，以验证单分子方法中荧光标记的DNA结合蛋白。
